_comment: FX-WEB-02: get_model_data — golden dispatch per event key, issue prefetch shape, error cases. Transcribed from bgtasks/webhook_task.py:58-90,143-187. Serializers themselves belong to other domains; only the class binding + dispatch rules are recorded here.

error_cases.when: SERIALIZER_MAPPER.get(event) is None (unreachable while both mappers share keys; port the check order: model lookup, queryset fetch, THEN serializer lookup)
model.objects.get/filter raises ObjectDoesNotExist (single-get path). many=True with zero matches does NOT raise: filter returns [] and the serializer renders [].

error_cases.note: Single-issue path re-fetches with .filter(pk).prefetch_related(...).first(); a missing issue raises at the first .get, so .first() returning None is unreachable there — but if it ever were None, the code would call the serializer with None (no guard). Port as-is.

issue_prefetch.many_false: issue = model.objects.get(pk=event_id); queryset = model.objects.filter(pk=issue.id).prefetch_related(*prefetches).first(); serializer(queryset, many=False, context={'expand': ['labels', 'assignees']}).data

non_issue: serializer(queryset, many=many).data with NO context and NO prefetches (covers project/cycle/module/cycle_issue/module_issue/issue_comment/user/intake_issue, many true and false)
